title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
grouping: Three panels in a row labelled (a), (b), (c) under each in serif. (a) is the module: a robot-camera photo on top, an arrow down through a small circle into a pink rounded 'Value Functions' box, from which thin grey lines fan out both ways to two columns of small open circles - on the left each circle carries a score, on the right a skill name ('Find an apple' ... 'Go to the counter', with a '...' row). (b) and (c) each pair a horizontal bar chart of five 'Pick up the ...' skills (values 0 to 1.00) with the camera photo of the state that produced it.
shapes_depth: Flat: one pink rounded box, hairline grey spokes, open circles as nodes. Scores are bold small numerals coloured by value (green for 0.6/0.8, dark red for 0.2/0.1). Bars in (b) are pink where high and pale blue where near zero, on a lavender chart background with the skill text written inside the bars' rows; (c) shows all bars near zero.
proposed_highlight: The module keeps the same pink as the 'Value Functions' bubble of Figure 1, so it is recognisable across figures; it is the only filled shape in panel (a).
lesson: Draw a value-function module as a hub whose spokes fan out to every skill with its score printed at the spoke end (green high, red low), then pair a bar chart of those scores with the observation photo that produced them.
notes: Venue CoRL from Semantic Scholar (title match, venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2022 = S2 year and arXiv year. The caption also covers the visualised value-function space; type module-detail because panel (a) opens one block (the value functions) and (b)/(c) show its output. elements 'other' = open-circle node columns.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: affordance value functions for robot skills
taxonomy.note: architecture other = a bank of skill-conditioned value functions scoring every skill from one observation

insights.structure: Three panels in a row captioned (a), (b), (c) beneath: (a) a camera photo over a pink 'Value Functions' box with spokes fanning to two columns of open circles, (b) and (c) each a horizontal bar chart of five 'Pick up the ...' skills beside the camera photo that produced it.
insights.data: Per-skill scores are bold numerals at the left spoke ends coloured green (high) or dark red (low), skill names at the right spoke ends, and bar charts with values 0 to 1.00 on a lavender background.
insights.emphasis: The pink box is the only filled shape in (a) and reuses the Value Functions pink of Figure 1; high bars in (b) are pink against near-zero pale blue bars in (c).
insights.flow: In (a) the photo arrow runs down into the box and hairline spokes fan out left and right; (b) and (c) are read as chart-then-photo pairs left to right.
insights.avoid: Bar-chart text and score numerals are small and low-contrast at column width, and the symmetric left/right spoke fans split score from skill name across the figure.
